reviewNotes: Shane's complete nine-line marriage schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English, preserving his dry Joja, saloon and family humor, with the player placeholder and every dialogue control exact.

marriage_Fri.001.source: Hmm... I have to say, JojaMart has a much better selection of frozen dinners.
marriage_Fri.001.translation: Hmm... Trebuie să recunosc, JojaMart are o selecție mult mai bună de mâncăruri congelate.

marriage_Mon.001.source: I'm attached to these woods... lots of memories...
marriage_Mon.001.translation: Sunt atașat de pădurea aceasta... Multe amintiri...

marriage_Fri.000.source: Don't worry, this is only Joja Cola.
marriage_Fri.000.translation: Nu-ți face griji, este doar Joja Cola.

marriage_Fri.002.source: If I don't order a cold one now and then, Gus will go out of business. I'm just doing my civic duty. I'll head home around 10.
marriage_Fri.002.translation: Dacă nu comand câte o bere rece din când în când, Gus va da faliment. Doar îmi fac datoria civică. Mă îndrept spre casă pe la 10.

marriage_Mon.000.translation: O, salut, @. Deja ți-e dor de mine?$6

winter_15.000.source: I'm taking a night off from the saloon for Jas' sake...
winter_15.000.translation: Îmi iau o seară liberă de la tavernă, de dragul lui Jas...

marriage_Sun.001.source: I've got cola block... do I pick Joja Classic or Joja Bluu? I might be here a while...
marriage_Sun.001.translation: Am un blocaj de cola... să aleg Joja Classic sau Joja Bluu? S-ar putea să stau ceva timp aici...

marriage_Fri.003.source: I'll just play one more round...$h
